sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority for the Connecticut Class D knowledge test

Issuer: the Connecticut Department of Motor Vehicles issues driver licenses and publishes the Connecticut Driver’s Manual [A03].
Edition: the imprint page prints the edition line “Revised March 2023” [A03]; no effective date is printed, so the effective date stays unconfirmed (verify — sec07-A-EFFECTIVE-DATE).
Exam path: a first time applicant passes a vision test and a 25-question knowledge test to earn a learner permit [A07], then a road test for the license [A09].
Scoring: the knowledge test spans 25 questions with 20 correct answers needed to pass [A07]; the manual states no time limit, which stays unknown (verify — sec07-A-TIME-LIMIT).
Question format: beyond samples on the DMV mobile app, the manual does not describe the item format of the knowledge test (verify — sec07-A-FORMAT).
Section link: this dossier section covers driver distractions, fatigue, drowsy driving, health and emotions, all drawn from the manual the test is built on [A29].
Practice mastery targets in this product are product policy from the accepted learning loop, never an official passing line.
Dynamic facts (updatable): cited studies and quoted risk multiples age with research, so they are kept out of stable knowledge [A30]; why_dynamic: figures outside the printed rules of the road.

corpus_stability.reason: The Connecticut Driver’s Manual is one dated edition (Revised March 2023, physical p3); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Effective date of the Connecticut Driver’s Manual: the imprint page prints the edition Revised March 2023 but no effective date, and the issuer manuals page states none
Knowledge test time limit is not stated in the manual (knowledge test paragraph, physical p7)
Knowledge test item format (e.g. multiple choice) is not described; the manual states only that sample tests sit on the DMV mobile app
